'''Dumbopus''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Dazopus]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Dumbopus's head feels itchy. Wonder why..."

Dumbopus is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small, blue/cyan octopus with an orange fish egg in its head.

Dumbopus's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form changes the orange fish egg into pink.

== Evolution Trial ==
Dumbopus's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Dazopus]] you need to complete the following task:

* In Tatari Catcher, capture 40 Tatari.

==Strategy==
[[File:Dumbopus.attack.range..png|left|thumb|Dumbopus’s attack range]]
Dumbopus is best as a mid or end-field attacker for its AoE damage. It is not as strong as other water DPS Tatari like [[Sealing]] or [[Droppit]], though it’s still decent.
{{clear|left}}

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Huh? Me again? Could I maybe... NOT fight [[Zobos]]!?"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Sometimes, even Dumbopus can't explain the strange thoughts that frequently come to mind."
